mapper.sql: SELECT a.ad_id, a.slot_code, a.title, a.image_url, a.link_url, a.link_type, a.link_target_type, a.link_target_id, a.start_at, a.end_at, a.is_active, a.sort_order, a.view_count, a.click_count, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.created_by, u.nickname AS creator_nickname FROM AD_CAMPAIGN a LEFT JOIN USERS u ON a.created_by = u.user_idx
mapper.select: WHERE a.slot_code = #{slotCode} AND a.is_active = 1 AND (a.start_at IS NULL OR a.start_at <= NOW()) AND (a.end_at IS NULL OR a.end_at > NOW()) ORDER BY a.sort_order ASC, a.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE AD_CAMPAIGN SET slot_code = #{slotCode}, title = #{title}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, link_type = #{linkType}, link_target_type = #{linkTargetType}, link_target_id = #{linkTargetId}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, is_active = #{isActive}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
UPDATE AD_CAMPAIGN SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
UPDATE AD_CAMPAIGN SET click_count = click_count + 1 WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
